Types/ConstantTables.reason: Globals whose braced lists are constants start as data in the image (const ones read-only), not as code before main: Bedrock's tables cost every program 2,360 start-up stores before

Types/VolatileStore.reason: D-29: volatile locals, globals and fields load and store with volatile operations.

Types/ThreadLocalCounter.reason: D-29: a thread_local global or local is LLVM thread_local storage.

Types/Atomics.reason: D-60: the atomic intrinsics lower to LLVM atomic loads, stores, read-modify-writes, compare-exchanges and fences (a bool through its byte).

Simd/WideVectorsAvx2.reason: D-62: every function carries the build's target, and the intrinsics lower to LLVM's.

Simd/TargetMacros.reason: D-62: without flags every function is compiled for the baseline x86-64.

Types/StrictAliasingUnions.reason: D-64: loads and stores carry !tbaa tags; a member of a union of several classes is tagged bytes, which aliases every class.

Types/StrictAliasingStructPointers.reason: D-64: a float, a pointer and an int32 access each carry their own class, so a float store does not make the loop reload pointers.

Types/Bug254VolatileObjectWithVptrs.reason: BUG-254: assigning an object with vptrs to a volatile variable is a volatile store (D-29).
